project.description:
The SDF ray-march technique. Takes an SdfScene — a Surface, a Shading model, march settings, a camera — and composes the fullscreen vertex+fragment pair that renders it, as SupirVast `core` IR lowered to SPIR-V. This is the ShaderComposer seat that vexelray-shader has been reserving for "an SDF composer turns a signed-distance scene into a fullscreen fragment".
The scene is a record all the way down, so ShaderKey collapses equal scenes onto one compiled shader set with no bespoke fingerprinting, and the ShaderCache serves them.
Not yet a RenderTechnique: the SPI's runtime (Phase 2) does not exist. What is here is the part that does not depend on it — composition — and the module is named for what it becomes.
